selected_unit.responsibility: Produce and assess one source-bound operation-plus-rival-plus-defeat card.
selected_unit.level: Case-block experimental interface between generation and downstream preservation.
selected_unit.inputs: Immutable outcome, evidence, constraints, family archive, operator, comparator, verified resource inventory.
selected_unit.outputs: Raw-ID card or no-opening; probe specification; fit gate; lineage; paired assessment.
selected_unit.recomposition: Cards feed P09 compression, P10 exposure and gated mechanism/human studies without changing raw claims.
selected_unit.missing_glue: I01 calibration; fresh packets/archives; timed feasibility evidence; physical supplies and human access; independent review; typed receipts.

priorities: First: I01 rubric/receipt calibration and I09 repair.
Compositions only after standalone feasibility; retain P09/P10 followups in track B.
assumptions: B means two diagnostic pilot blocks: library and kit; then four untouched confirmation blocks: two hammer-like mechanical-design and two analysis-workflow tasks. Never pool strata or select successful cases.

O=ordinary, G=generic creativity; equal evidence/output allowances. Budgets count one native role per arm/block, two independent reviewers/block, and at most one scalar adjudicator/phase; no scored retries; shared controls are not independent discoveries.

Shared fresh-packet/archive/preflight preparation ceiling:12 native roles, charged once in I01. B measures method outputs; physical subprobe observations require their own frozen units/resource gates and never masquerade as native replicates.
Q retains frozen qualification and local family definitions; report planned, valid, evaluable and unresolved denominators. Budget ceilings authorize no execution now.

Freeze new supplied facts/archives and dry-run logistical capacity before fit credit. Probe feasibility and deployment feasibility are separate gates; a stop cap alone proves neither. Confirmation requires informative feasibility and intact contracts, not positive novelty; run all heldout blocks, never replace no-openings.

Model judgment, raw distinction, feasible test, retention, visibility and world/decision effects remain separate. No physical equipment or participants supplied; field budgets deferred behind access gates.
rejected_alternative: Full-recipe versus ordinary alone: cannot identify which operation caused gain, permits post-summary invention, and conflates convergence with whole-skill effects.
